description: Source code for AUTOSAR COM module implementation, including signal handling, PDU transmission, reception, and indication functions.

methods.name: Com_SendSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal by writing data to the PDU buffer, setting update bits, and triggering transmission if configured.

methods.name: Com_ReceiveSignal
methods.description: Receives a signal by reading data from the PDU buffer, considering deferred processing and buffer lock status.

methods.name: Com_ReceiveDynSignal
methods.description: Receives a dynamic signal, copying data from PDU buffer to application buffer, with length validation.

methods.name: Com_SendDynSignal
methods.description: Sends a dynamic signal by copying data into the PDU buffer, setting update bits, and triggering transmission if configured.

methods.name: Com_TriggerTransmit
methods.description: Prepares PDU data for transmission by copying from internal buffer to PDU info structure.

methods.name: Com_Internal_TriggerIPduSend
methods.description: Internal function to trigger IPDU transmission, checking timers, callouts, and invoking PDU router transmit.

methods.name: Com_TriggerIPduSend
methods.description: Wrapper to call internal trigger function for IPDU transmission.

methods.name: Com_RxIndication
methods.description: Handles reception indication, copying received data into internal buffers, and processing signals.

methods.name: Com_TpRxIndication
methods.description: Handles transport protocol reception indication, unlocking buffers, and processing signals based on result.

methods.name: Com_TpTxConfirmation
methods.description: Handles transport protocol transmission confirmation, unlocking buffers.

methods.name: Com_SendSignalGroup
methods.description: Sends a signal group by copying shadow buffer to PDU data, setting update bits, and triggering transmission.

methods.name: Com_ReceiveSignalGroup
methods.description: Receives a signal group by copying PDU data to shadow buffer.

methods.name: Com_UpdateShadowSignal
methods.description: Updates shadow buffer with new signal data.

methods.name: Com_ReceiveShadowSignal
methods.description: Reads signal data from shadow buffer into application buffer.
